name: github-sync-webapp
description: Admin web app for the GitHub-to-Google-Chat critical issue sync. Lets the Administrator sign in, connect their GitHub account, manage the watched-repository list, configure the destination Google Chat space, and review the notification log. Holds no business logic of its own — every action calls github-sync-api.

dependencies.name: github-sync-api
dependencies.description: All configuration and status data — watched repositories, the Chat destination, the GitHub connection, and the notification log.
